classification.source: authenticated native registration identity, artifact root and active catalog
classification.claim_class_and_rules: authenticated admission EconomicsSnapshot; FOW1 context fixed before TB1 EXEC release
classification.trade_class_and_rules: active canonical state when the transaction executes

registration.seed_or_deepen: optional liquidity addition to the existing market
registration.missing_additional_market: state-invariant violation; reject invalid transition or unresolved migration state
registration.failure: rollback registration and market initialization together

reward.R: canonical successful claim's priced and capped worker reward before buyback and role distribution

ADDITIONAL.role_distribution: versioned reward_plan_id applies only to D
ADDITIONAL.old_20_percent_panel_example_only: P = floor(200*D/1000); M = D-P if there are no other reward legs

reward.core_verification_services: separate pre-funded finite escrow and signed consent; no deductions from or double-pledging of R
reward.insufficient_service_funds: reject new obligations, not verification waiver

normal_amm_trade.buy_min_out_unit: Position output units after using net BILI in the curve
normal_amm_trade.sell_min_out_unit: net BILI actually received by seller
normal_amm_trade.invalid_owner_recipient: reject; do not silently burn or reroute

protocol_buyback.zero_units_due_to_rounding: B remains credited to reserve; not refunded to Miner or owner

direct_position_transfer.evm_success_requires: same-transaction native journal update with atomic balances, allowance, logs and rollback
direct_position_transfer.off_market_consideration: not automatically subject to the AMM 5%/3% fees

migration.additional_balances_and_reserves: preserve; verify registration-market invariant before activation
migration.core_old_markets_balances_allowances_obl: explicit rights-preserving winddown before activation or designation

model_governance.GENESIS: immutable original genesis; no BFT model management
model_governance.ADDITIONAL: automatic or BFT admission; BFT stop/resume applies to both
model_governance.FORK_DESIGNATED: BFT YES may add; core economics, BFT stop/resume applies
